title: UK Structural Engineers Declare (SED)
bullets: Uphold signatory commitments by actively promoting climate emergency awareness and sustainable design principles

Engage with the Structural Sustainability regional representatives (Jack Brunton, Ioana Price, Margaret Hanway and Megan Newson) for guidance on implementing SED principles in client interactions and project delivery
Embed sustainability thinking as a core consideration in all engineering decisions and recommendations

title: Knowledge sharing platform
bullets: Engage regularly with the Structural Sustainability SharePoint site, including the monthly bulletins and themed newsletters, technical resources and sustainability updates
Contribute project experiences through case studies, lessons learned or technical insights that benefit the broader team

title: Continuous development
bullets: Stay current with sustainability developments including new tools, standards and industry best practices
Participate in training opportunities related to sustainable design, carbon assessment and circular economy principles

title: Eco.Zero™ deployment
bullets: Apply Eco.Zero Concept tool for early-stage (RIBA 0/1) carbon and cost optioneering to influence sustainable design decisions across structural typologies

For Revit projects, implement Eco.Zero Measure for systematic carbon tracking (mandatory where the design stage fee thresholds are met), enabling identification of carbon hotspots, reporting and benchmarking, and implementation of reduction strategies
Collaborate with the Structural Sustainability team to effectively deploy Eco.Zero tools and maximise their impact on project sustainability outcomes

title: Structural decarbonisation throughout project lifecycle
bullets: Where Eco.Zero Concept is not applicable, undertake manual optioneering studies and estimate associated carbon using IStructE Structural Carbon Tool or other means
Monitor and report structural carbon across all design stages, leveraging Eco.Zero Measure as appropriate, to determine a baseline and demonstrate continual reduction throughout the project lifecycle

title: Mandatory actions
bullets: Complete the mandatory actions on your projects, including Eco.Zero Measure and Structural Sustainability reviews where the design stage fee thresholds are met, and keep a record of completed actions so that progress can be tracked on a regional basis
Check which mandatory actions apply to your project using the Structural Sustainability SharePoint site, and speak to your regional representative if you are unsure

title: Climate change resilience
bullets: Consider climate change resilience in structural design, including how the structure will perform and adapt under future climate conditions, and raise it with clients and project teams from the early design stages
Design for adaptability and longevity so that resilience is achieved without adding embodied carbon that the project does not need

title: Driving a cultural shift towards sustainable design
bullets: Drive cultural shift towards sustainable service delivery by promoting SED commitments in team meetings, project reviews, and client interactions, tracked through sustainability discussion frequency, team member confidence in sustainability conversations, and integration of sustainable principles into standard project workflows by Q4 FY27

Establish regular engagement with Structural Sustainability team to embed sustainable thinking into daily engineering decisions, evidenced by monthly consultation records, project sustainability reviews, and demonstrated culture change towards sustainable design as standard practice

title: Driving sustainable design leadership and business development in key markets
bullets: Promote early-stage (RIBA 0-1) Structural Sustainability input by championing the value add of Eco.Zero optioneering capabilities in client engagement, measured through increased early-stage project engagement and client recognition of sustainability value by Q4 FY27

Integrate Structural Sustainability team expertise and Eco.Zero capabilities into bid responses and client proposals, measured through enhanced bid quality, sustainability value propositions, and demonstration of SED commitments in business development activities

Develop new client relationships by inviting the Structural Sustainability team to present expertise to architects, clients and project teams, evidenced by presentations delivered, resulting project proposals and appointments, and positive client feedback on sustainability advisory services

Establish reputation for sustainability leadership through consistent application of SED principles and Eco.Zero tools across project portfolio, measured through client testimonials, case study development, and enhanced market positioning for sustainable structural design

title: Embedding sustainability excellence across operations
bullets: Implement Eco.Zero Measure carbon tracking across the project portfolio to establish an embodied carbon baseline and implement systematic carbon reduction strategies, measured through consistent application of carbon assessment tools, project carbon profiles, case studies and lessons learned by Q4 FY27

Proactively promote Structural Sustainability reviews across the business and hold project teams to account for completing the actions arising, tracked through review completion and the regional tracking of mandatory actions

title: Leading sustainable design culture change
bullets: Champion SED principles and drive a cultural shift towards sustainability as a core engineering competency within the department by facilitating monthly sustainability discussions, challenging conventional design approaches and promoting SED commitments in project planning, design reviews and professional development conversations, measured through sustainability-focused project decisions and integration into standard departmental processes and procedures by Q4 FY27

Collaborate regularly with Structural Sustainability team to build department capability in sustainable design thinking, evidenced by consultation frequency, knowledge transfer sessions, and team member confidence in applying sustainable principles to project challenges

title: Enhancing client experience through sustainability innovation
bullets: Contribute case studies and technical articles to the Structural Sustainability newsletter showcasing Eco.Zero applications and SED implementation, evidenced by published content and knowledge sharing with broader team

Lead bid writing and proposals that promote Structural Sustainability credentials through Eco.Zero capabilities and SED principles, measured through enhanced bid quality, sustainability value propositions, and client recognition of carbon optioneering expertise

Develop client engagement strategies that showcase early-stage sustainability intervention using Eco.Zero optioneering tools, tracked through client feedback, project appointment success, and demonstration of sustainable design value

title: Maximising Structural Sustainability team consultation and Eco.Zero use in project delivery
bullets: Facilitate regular Structural Sustainability team consultation on department projects, incorporating Eco.Zero optioneering and Measure tools for enhanced sustainability outcomes, measured through consultation engagement, project carbon performance improvements, and team feedback on collaborative working

Develop and implement systematic sustainability integration processes for project stages (RIBA 0-6) incorporating Eco.Zero tools and SED principles, evidenced by process documentation, team capability development, and consistent application across applicable projects
Ensure projects in the department complete the mandatory actions where the thresholds are met, evidenced by completion rates in the regional tracking of mandatory actions
